name: m11-w4
note: I3, the NIAH-style doc-needle guardrail: one planted UUID in a 128k-token document, 25 depths x 5 documents plus 5 negative controls, both arms in document mode. H2a is met iff A2 misses at most one more of the 25 than A0 (Evaluation.md §6.3, §9 W4). The A2 arm turns the verifier on against the record text (LENS_DOCUMENT_EVIDENCE=1), which is the one document instrument where the UUID claim is mechanically checkable. The query list below is a two-instance placeholder; the real wave is 30 instances x 2 arms (expect 60), and m11-waves.json carries the placeholder count until the generator lands.

arms.name: a0-doc
arms.note: A0-doc: one call over the needle document.

arms.name: a2-doc
arms.note: A2-doc with the evidence-on sub-mode: the claim pass and the final gate read the record text, so a cited record either contains the code or does not.
